justification: The Farm to Fork Strategy aims to reduce the environmental footprint of food systems, which is in line with the European Climate Law's goal of reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Implementing the Farm to Fork Strategy's targets can aid in achieving the European Climate Law's objectives.
The Farm to Fork Strategy's focus on sustainable agriculture can enable the implementation of the amended Directive 2003/87/EC, which aims to reduce emissions from aviation.
The Farm to Fork Strategy's emphasis on sustainable land use can facilitate the implementation of the amended Regulations (EU) 2018/841, which aim to reduce emissions from land use.

impact_policydoc: On an EU Strategy to reduce methane emissions
justification: The Farm to Fork Strategy's targets on reducing methane emissions from agriculture can reinforce the EU Strategy to reduce methane emissions, which aims to decrease methane emissions from all sectors.
The Farm to Fork Strategy's focus on energy efficiency in buildings can be enabled by the Renovation Wave for Europe, which aims to improve the energy performance of buildings.
The recast of the urban wastewater treatment directive can aid in achieving the Farm to Fork Strategy's objectives on reducing pollution from agriculture.
The amended Directive 2003/87/EC can facilitate the implementation of the Farm to Fork Strategy's targets on reducing emissions from aviation.
The amended Regulations (EU) 2018/841 can aid in achieving the Farm to Fork Strategy's objectives on sustainable land use.
